handoff.summary: precond: socom precond velocity-first pre-flight (backlog #3 precond half)
handoff.done:
Backlog #3 (precond half) shipped, gates green, pushed, CI verified green (headSha ef1cdb3 -> success). Third Akili->SOCOM extraction.
`socom precond [seat] [--no-heal]` (commit ea71c32): a velocity-first work-readiness pre-flight — the "published gate" doctrine made real, the before-bookend to gates (which only check after work). - Checks: substrate dirs, git+python3, hooks wired, checks bound, drift, claim held (production seats). Each prints pass/healed/warn/block. - Velocity-first per operator feedback: AUTO-HEALS safe gaps (mkdir, git config), WARNS by default, blocks ONLY the unrecoverable; exit 0 unless a real blocker. --no-heal is the CI assert posture. Prints elapsed ms. - Distinct from doctor (substrate health, static) — precond is work readiness, seat-aware, healing. Extracted SUBSTRATE_DIRS as the single source of truth shared by init + precond.
Contract (all PASS, evidence in ea71c32 [test]): healthy repo -> PASS 25ms exit 0; missing dir + --no-heal -> RED exit 1, dir NOT created; plain run -> heals it, exit 0; no-claim -> WARN but exit 0. Full smoke green (6 new precond assertions, heal+block directions). doctor clean (source=fce8a0829b46, no canon change). CI green post-push.
handoff.undone: #3's ASSESSMENT-ARTIFACT half is deferred (not built): schemas/assessment.xml + multi-dimensional assessment beyond a single reviewer. Judged already-covered-enough by the reviewer/adversary/validator seats + promise.<assessments>; revisit only if the seats prove insufficient. Also deferred: a formal `work-start` gate in canon + checks.precond CI binding (kept precond advisory per the velocity constraint — no mandatory blocking stop); seat-specific worktree/contract-exists checks.

handoff.warnings: - precond is advisory (a command), not wired into any gate or the bootstrap ritual yet — nothing calls it automatically. Deliberate (velocity: no mandatory stop). If adopted into session bootstrap, add it as guidance, not a blocking gate. - precond's claim check keys on claim_holder() (SOCOM_SESSION env or pid-<ppid>); across separate shells the pid differs, so it may warn "no claim" even when one was taken in another shell. Fine in a real single-session run. - .socom/index/chunks.jsonl shows modified: pre-push `full` check runs `socom index .` on the real repo. Pre-existing churn, left untouched.
